mechanism: Naloxone may antagonize the CNS depressant effects of meprobamate, potentially reducing its therapeutic efficacy while increasing risk of withdrawal or rebound anxiety if meprobamate is being used for sedation/anxiolysis.
action: Monitor for reduced meprobamate efficacy and increased anxiety/CNS symptoms; use naloxone cautiously in patients on chronic meprobamate therapy and consider alternative sedatives if opioid reversal is necessary.
